mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 5.5% signals a weak labor market and potential for monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate is below 0.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 260, it signals Fed policy of low rates to combat inflation, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 260

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5 and rising for 3 months

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate a strengthening economy, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Correlation between HOUST and 20-day returns is negative or insignificant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100

mechanism_narrative: When employment levels (PAYEMS) fall below 140,000 thousand persons and unemployment (UNRATE) rises above 5.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, prompting monetary policy easing that leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 140000 AND UNRATE > 5.5

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (RSAFS > 600,000), high retail sales (RSAFS) signal continued economic strength, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 600000
